correctness.rationale: The multiplication operator splits into the internal triangle, one signed triangle per external vertex, and a zero block. The three signs of each external triangle can be conjugated by a diagonal sign matrix to a common sign equal to their product. Thus only negative external triangles contribute a -1 eigenvalue, once each. A triple sign containing two fixed vertices of B and a variable external vertex is a separate fair pivot for each Pasch sign in B's star. If C meets B in at most one vertex, choose the two fixed vertices outside C so these pivots never occur in C's star. If C meets B in two vertices, choose one shared vertex and the respective nonshared vertex to form disjoint pivots for the two stars outside B union C. The unique common Pasch remains an independent shared fair bit. Conditional expectations of the two profile indicators given that bit are a_k and b_k (respectively a_l and b_l); their covariance is the stated quarter product. There are 3(m-3) such neighbors per block, counted in ordered pairs, and the diagonal is the one-block multinomial term. This includes m=4: all four blocks share one fair bit, so Var(T_0)=4. For a threshold indicator only O(Nm) of the N^2 covariances can be nonzero. Chebyshev and summability of O(m^-2), applied at rational thresholds and countably many tolerances, give almost-sure convergence to the binomial expectations, which converge by the binomial CLT. Continuity gives weak convergence under any cross-dimension coupling.
residual_risks: No joint law or fluctuation CLT for the complete profile vector is established. The finite enumerations and sampling in the package are diagnostics, not premises of the proof.

value.rationale: The exact overlap correction quantifies when treating an existing, naturally sampled spectral profile as multinomial gives incorrect uncertainty. It covers all profile bins, including their cross-covariances, not only a mean or one variance. The strong law then shows that this local dependence does not obstruct a Gaussian shape for a typical large decoration. This supplies a usable baseline for the computationally sampled profiles in the prior work.
residual_risks: The baseline is for independent fair decorations at the distinguished block idempotents, not constrained signs or arbitrary idempotents.
